lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters are arranged in approximately four primary horizontal rows posterior to the fifth gill slit. The uppermost row features the largest and most distinct centroids with a regular inter-blob spacing of roughly 2.0 diameters. Centroids on the lower flank and transition zone to the pectoral fin exhibit reduced diameter and increased density.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, particularly evident in the mid-flank region, creating a subtle grid-like alignment of high-intensity nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature runs horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, showing a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity specular highlights on the dorsal edge and a defined shadow cast on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct sub-cylindrical shadows and low-luminance silhouettes representing remoras (Echeneidae) are visible ventral to the gill slits and the anterior base of the pectoral fin.
